metricDefinitions.userCount: 전체 회원 수 (User 테이블 row count).
metricDefinitions.usersLast7d: DEPRECATED. newUsersLast7d 와 동일한 값(최근 7일 신규 가입). 활성 사용자/DAU/WAU/방문자가 아님. 절대 active users 로 해석하지 말 것.
metricDefinitions.newUsersLast7d: analysisPeriod 내 신규 가입자 수 (User.createdAt in Asia/Seoul window). NOT active users, NOT DAU/WAU, NOT GA4 newUsers.
metricDefinitions.activeUsersLast7d: analysisPeriod 내 활성 사용자 수. 정의: 해당 기간에 Post 작성·Comment 작성·PostLike·Bookmark·GameScore(updatedAt) 중 하나 이상. 신규 가입(newUsersLast7d)·GA4 activeUsers와 동일시 금지. null이면 집계 실패.
metricDefinitions.postsLast7d: analysisPeriod 내 작성 게시글 수 (Post.createdAt in Asia/Seoul window).
metricDefinitions.commentsLast7d: analysisPeriod 내 작성 댓글 수 (Comment.createdAt in Asia/Seoul window).
metricDefinitions.viewsLast7d: analysisPeriod 내 조회수 합 (PostViewDaily.count for day keys matching analysisPeriod start..end). Post.views(누적 totalViews)로 추정 금지. 버킷이 비면 0일 수 있음(배포 이후부터 적재).
metricDefinitions.totalViews: 전체 기간 게시글 조회수 합 (Post.views sum). 최근 7일 조회수가 아님.

docsHints: Jury product projection v9.x-ev020. Metrics outside EvidencePack are withheld.

metricDefinitions.activeUsers: GA4 activeUsers (reporting API, selected date range). NOT the same as DB aggregates.activeUsersLast7d (Post|Comment|Like|Bookmark|GameScore). Do not equate or substitute. Cite source as GA4.
metricDefinitions.newUsers: GA4 newUsers in the selected date range. NOT the same as DB newUsersLast7d (signups). Cite source as GA4.
metricDefinitions.sessions: GA4 sessions in the selected date range. Not DB signups or posts.
metricDefinitions.screenPageViews: GA4 screenPageViews (web page views). NOT the same as DB viewsLast7d (PostViewDaily) or totalViews (Post.views sum). Cite source as GA4.
metricDefinitions.engagedSessions: GA4 engagedSessions in the selected date range.
metricDefinitions.engagementRate: GA4 engagementRate in the selected date range (0–1). DIRECT_FACT only; "low engagement" is INFERENCE.
metricDefinitions.averageSessionDurationSec: GA4 averageSessionDuration in seconds (API metric averageSessionDuration).
metricDefinitions.eventCountByName: GA4 eventCount keyed by eventName for tracked custom events only. Missing key = not observed in range (do not invent). Actual 0 means zero events.
